tests.name: dump_17_digit_signed_integer
tests.intent: Verify serialization of 17-digit positive signed integers handled by the new fast path.

tests.name: dump_18_digit_signed_integer
tests.intent: Verify serialization of 18-digit positive signed integers handled by the new fast path.

tests.name: dump_19_digit_signed_integer
tests.intent: Verify serialization of 19-digit positive signed integers handled by the new fast path.

tests.name: dump_20_digit_max_int64
tests.intent: Verify serialization of the maximum 64-bit signed integer (9223372036854775807) using the fast path.

tests.name: dump_negative_17_digit_integer
tests.intent: Verify negative 17-digit integers use sign removal and then hit the 17-digit fast path.

tests.name: dump_negative_20_digit_min_int64
tests.intent: Verify the minimum 64-bit signed integer (-9223372036854775808) correctly dumps through the magnitude path.

tests.name: dump_17_digit_unsigned_integer
tests.intent: Verify 17-digit unsigned integer serialization with the new fast path.

tests.name: dump_max_uint64
tests.intent: Verify maximum 64-bit unsigned integer (18446744073709551615ULL) serialization using the fast path.

tests.name: dump_boundary_16_digit_integer
tests.intent: Verify upper boundary of the old 16-digit fast path (9999999999999999ULL) transitions correctly.

tests.name: dump_small_integer_reference
tests.intent: Verify small integers continue to dump correctly after the changes to serializer.

tests.name: dump_zero_integer
tests.intent: Verify zero integer dumps correctly.

tests.name: dump_various_digit_counts
tests.intent: Loop through various digit lengths around 16 to 20 digits to ensure consistent string output.

tests.name: ordered_json_18_digit_integer
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json also correctly handles 18-digit integers via the same underlying serializer path.

tests.name: dump_integer_stream_insertion
tests.intent: Verify stream insertion operator output for a 17-digit integer matches dump().

tests.name: dump_integer_pretty_print
tests.intent: Verify that pretty-printing indentation does not interfere with the 17-digit integer fast path output.

tests.name: dump_integer_array_elements
tests.intent: Verify array serialization containing multiple 17 to 20 digit integers.

tests.name: dump_integer_object_values
tests.intent: Verify object serialization containing 17 to 20 digit integers as values.

tests.name: dump_max_digits_all_nines_19
tests.intent: Verify serialization of 19-digit number consisting entirely of nines.

tests.name: dump_max_digits_all_nines_20
tests.intent: Verify serialization of 20-digit number consisting entirely of nines within 64-bit limits.

tests.name: gen_20
tests.intent: Exercise magnitude_fits_64_bits with std::false_type overload by passing a custom number type or manipulating basic_json with a wider number magnitude type if possible, or trigger through explicit instantiation/calls.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Explicitly test helper function checks for magnitude fitting 64 bits using large numbers near the boundary.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Check 17 to 20 digit numbers with basic_json configured or interacted via standard numeric limits traits check.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Serialize a 20-digit number that forces the serializer's magnitude_fits_64_bits evaluation path.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Dump various unsigned 64-bit integer limits and large numbers to ensure the serializer templates are fully instantiated.
